## Bug report (verbatim, from the user)
Our log indexer has been filing every afternoon event under the morning: a 14:30 boot shows up as 02:30. Morning lines look fine, afternoon lines are all shifted by twelve hours. The service logs in 24-hour time. Fix the parser so afternoon hours come out right; don't touch the line format itself.

```python
"""Parse structured lines from the service log.

Line shape: "<YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS> <LEVEL> <message>"
"""

from datetime import datetime

STAMP_LEN = 19  # "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"


def parse_ts(line: str) -> datetime:
    stamp = line[1:1 + STAMP_LEN]
    return datetime.strptime(stamp, "%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S")


def level(line: str) -> str:
    return line[22:26].strip()

```

"""Timestamp parsing tests (24-hour service log)."""

from datetime import datetime

from logparse.parser import parse_ts


def test_afternoon_hour_is_parse():
    ts = parse_ts("[2025-06-01 14:30:00] INFO boot ok")
    assert ts == datetime(2025, 6, 1, 14, 30, 0)


def test_morning_hour_unchanged():
    ts = parse_ts("[2025-06-01 09:15:00] WARN slow disk")
    assert ts == datetime(2025, 6, 1, 9, 15, 0)
